The speed-time graph shows a cyclist’s ride between two villages.

Calculate the distance between the two villages.
Give your answer in kilometres.
Calculate the average speed of the cyclist for the whole ride.

ms:

M1 for dividing their area by 60 (or working with 24 km/h = 0.4 km/min)
A1
600 scores M1 only
